items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: But it was for Nicole Barclay Barkley, and she was trying to get Errol to record for her then.

ctx.x: You and Kenny Clark and whom else was (Inaudible) on the date?

Oh, some of the guys in Howard's group. I forgot who it was. Some -- yeah. But Kenny as I said, Kenny was -- it was his date, I really believe it was his date. But it was for Nicole Barclay Barkley, and she was trying to get Errol to record for her then. I don't think he would, for personal reasons, you know. But he didn't record for her. But I'm sure that we did -- I know that we did some recordings during that time.

But Hawk as I said at this time, it was just tremendous his going back, because he was so well loved, in Europe. He was quite a big man there. And this was his first time back there. So they didn't boo Hawk. Neither did they boo us, but they would boo -- every time Howard McGhee played they would just boo because they just could not accept bebop.
